evidence_quotes.O: The included 18-55 zoom feels mechanically solid for a kit lens, and it's also fairly sharp corner to corner. There's very little geometric distortion or chromatic aberration.
evidence_quotes.C: A card slot accepts a Sony memory stick which can be used either to extend shooting time or as a backup to the internal memory.
evidence_quotes.E: This little device serves many uses, from secretly recording live conversations to recording the fun at a party.
evidence_quotes.A: This is misleading and deceptive advertising, and Samsung should remove any reference to "optical zoom" from this camcorder, especially since it's printed on the front of the camcorder.
evidence_quotes.N: I have to keep reminding myself this camera is only 200 dollars. The video quality it produces is well beyond what I expected in a 200 dollar camcorder.
